newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk trader sells Iraq sugar, buys Argentine wheat.
newsitem.headline: Turk trader sells Iraq sugar, buys Argentine wheat.

text.p: A Turkish trading company and flour producer, Besler, said on Wednesday it was selling 5,500 tonnes of ICUMSA-45 sugar to various buyers in northern Iraq at prices between $410 and $430 per tonne.
Its General Manager Cemal Besler said the company was buying 20,000 tonnes of milling wheat from Argentina to produce flour for export purposes.
"We got 3,000 tonnes of sugar from local suppliers and 2,500 tonnes of imported sugar from the free trade zone in Mersin port," Besler told Reuters.
"The sugar is of good quality, ICUMSA-45 sugar," he said.
"The last batch of 9,000 tonnes of the Argentine wheat will arrive in a few days. We have already bought 11,000 tonnes of our deal," he said.
Besler, whose company is located in the southern city of Gaziantep, said the plant would use the wheat to produce flour for export purposes.
He would not give the price of the Argentine wheat.
